items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Ewan was in school. William Houston was in school. So, the school boys.

ctx.x: But you had to work when you were with Robert Clark, I bet, to make it on. You couldn't make it on one or two nights a week.

You know, because most of those fellas were in there. Going to school, Clyde Kerr was in school. Ewan was in school. William Houston was in school. So, the school boys. Well, I had a little job working.
You were not asking what you did? Oh, no.
